FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.title: Scrap Ooze
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.INITIAL.descript:
You spot an ooze that has eaten an array of junk. However, something shines from within...

Should you reach into the dangerous slime for it?
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.REACH.descriptio:
[red][jitter]Ouch![/jitter][/red]

After rummaging through the metal and burning acid, you finally grab hold of a [gold]relic[/gold] and yank it out.

You pull your way out of the ooze [red]damaged[/red] but rewarded.
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.STUDY.descriptio: Examining the Ooze, it eventually leads you towards a compartment with a potion!
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.title: Sputtering Furnace
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.INITIAL.d: You find a furnace sputtering and clinging to heat. The flames brighten as you draw near, beckoning you.
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.INITIAL.o: [green]Remove 1 card from your Deck.[/green] [red]Randomly remove another from your Deck.[/red]
[green]Upgrade a random card in your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 3 Max HP.[/red]
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.FEED.desc:
As you feed it, the flames [red][jitter]ROAR[/jitter][/red] to life!

You may have overfed it a little...
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.USE.descr: You decide to use the last of its flames to work. The heat is intense, but you manage to make use of it.
